gloss: interruption of service; being cut off

definitions.gloss: interruption; suspension of service; being cut off
definitions.explanation: A state in which a train line, road, or line of communication cannot be used because of an accident, a disaster, or bad weather. Most often said of trains and phone lines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不通|ふつう}になった。
⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不通|ふつう}になっている。
examples.english: The road is closed because of heavy snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不通|ふつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れなかった→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: Right after the earthquake the phone lines were down, and I couldn't reach my family.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不通|ふつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be cut off, to stop running
- {全線|ぜんせん}{不通|ふつう}: the whole line suspended
- ⟦{音信不通|おんしんふつう}→音信不通：15718_onshinfutsuu⟧: out of contact, not heard from
- {不通区間|ふつうくかん}: the section of line that is not running

WATCH OUT:
{不通|ふつう} is a homophone of ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ (ordinary; local train). In a train announcement, {不通|ふつう} means the line is not running, while ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ is the stopping train. The verb ⟦{通|つう}じない→通ずる：31647_tsuuzuru⟧ says the same thing in everyday speech: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じない→通ずる：31647_tsuuzuru⟧.
